title: Token Cleaning: Fine-Grained Data Selection for LLM Supervised Fine-Tuning
authors_zh: Jinlong Pang、Na Di、Zhaowei Zhu、Jiaheng Wei、Hao Cheng、Chen Qian、Yang Liu
paper_type_zh: 监督微调 Token 级数据筛选论文
best_for_zh: 需要分析 SFT 样本内部监督质量、而非只做整条样本过滤的读者。
one_line: Token Cleaning removes low-information supervision tokens according to their estimated influence on model updates.
Token Cleaning 按模型更新对每个 token 的影响筛除低信息监督，以更细粒度方式构造 SFT 训练目标。
why: It makes the link between an explicit data object and a training objective inspectable.
inclusion_reason: The paper changes how a training record, selection signal, reward, or trajectory is consumed by a post-training objective.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Sample-level data selection makes one keep-or-drop decision for an entire instruction-response pair. That assumes every target token in a retained response is useful supervision, even though one answer can mix task-relevant content with repetitions, low-information phrases, or harmful patterns.

Token Cleaning asks whether supervised fine-tuning can decide at token granularity which parts of an otherwise useful response should affect the update. It frames the unwanted tokens as noisy supervision and aims to preserve the parts that contribute useful learning signal.

样本级数据选择会对整条指令—回复对作出一次保留或丢弃决定。这假设被保留回复中的每个目标词元都是有用监督，尽管一条答案可能同时混有任务相关内容、重复、低信息短语或有害模式。

Token Cleaning 追问：监督微调能否在词元粒度上决定一条本来有用的回复中哪些部分应影响更新。它把不需要的词元视为带噪监督，目标是保留能贡献有用学习信号的部分。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The training object is a masked instruction-response target, not a newly written reasoning corpus. The original examples remain available, but different subsets of their target tokens are allowed to contribute to the supervised-fine-tuning loss.

The paper estimates the influence of each token on model updates and uses that estimate as a cleaning signal. This changes data consumption inside a record: the method can retain an example's useful content while suppressing tokens judged unlikely to help the intended model update.

训练对象是经过掩码处理的指令—回复目标，而不是新写成的推理语料。原始样本仍然存在，只是其中不同子集的目标词元被允许对监督微调损失作出贡献。

论文估计每个词元对模型更新的影响，并把该估计作为清洗信号。这改变了记录内部的数据消费方式：方法能够保留样本的有用内容，同时抑制被认为不太可能帮助目标模型更新的词元。

title: Method
方法
html:
A reference model provides token-level influence estimates used to identify low-value supervision. The paper studies a fixed-model version that performs this estimation in one pass and a self-evolving version that refreshes the reference model as cleaning proceeds.

A threshold converts the influence estimates into a mask over the response target, after which the masked targets are used for supervised fine-tuning. The official release provides code and a 50,000-example data resource, making the scoring and masking procedure inspectable rather than leaving it as an undocumented preprocessing step.

一个参考模型提供词元级影响估计，用来识别低价值监督。论文研究固定模型版本，它在一次过程中完成估计；也研究自演化版本，它会随着清洗推进而更新参考模型。

阈值把影响估计转化为回复目标上的掩码，之后用掩码后的目标进行监督微调。官方发布提供代码和五万条样本的数据资源，使评分和掩码过程可以检查，而不是把它留成没有记录的预处理步骤。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper compares fixed-model and self-evolving cleaning with full-token training and sample-level selection baselines on multiple downstream tasks. It reports consistent improvements, including gains of up to 6.3% in the reported evaluations, while using the same underlying examples more selectively.

The evidence is specific to the paper's models, data pools, masking choices, and downstream evaluations. It does not mean that each removed token is semantically wrong, or that the same threshold will preserve formatting, safety, and long-context requirements in every supervised-fine-tuning task.

论文在多个下游任务上，将固定模型和自演化清洗与全词元训练和样本级选择基线比较。它报告了持续改进，在所报告的评测中最高提升 6.3%，同时更有选择地使用相同的底层样本。

证据限定于论文的模型、数据池、掩码选择和下游评测。它并不意味着每个被删除的词元在语义上都是错误的，也不意味着同一阈值能在每项监督微调任务中保留格式、安全和长上下文要求。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Most data-cleaning methods accept or reject a complete example, and most training changes alter the optimizer while leaving every token in a selected target intact. Neither choice directly controls which pieces of supervision within a response generate gradients.

Token Cleaning moves the acceptance decision inside the target sequence and ties it to estimated update influence. Its novelty is therefore the token-level training target and the way it is constructed from existing data, rather than a new optimizer or a generic statement that shorter answers are better.

大多数数据清洗方法接受或拒绝一整条样本，而大多数训练改动只是改变优化器，同时让被选目标中的每个词元保持不变。这两种选择都不能直接控制回复内部哪些监督片段会产生梯度。

Token Cleaning 把接受决策移入目标序列内部，并将其与估计的更新影响相连。因此，新意在于词元级训练目标及其从既有数据构造的方式，而不在于新的优化器或“答案越短越好”的泛化说法。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Influence estimates depend on the reference model and threshold, and removing tokens can damage a response whose meaning depends on long-range context. Reuse should inspect masked examples, pin the reference checkpoint, and test whether task formatting or safety constraints were removed.
影响估计依赖参考模型和阈值，删除 token 也可能破坏需要长距离上下文的语义。复用时应抽查掩码样本、固定参考检查点，并测试任务格式或安全约束是否被误删。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it for a controlled SFT study when data examples are broadly useful but internally noisy: apply the released scoring pipeline, preserve the original records, train on masked targets, and compare against equal-token full and sample-level filtering baselines.
当样本总体有用但内部监督噪声较高时，可运行发布的评分流程，保留原始记录、以掩码后的目标训练，并与等 token 数的全量数据和样本级过滤基线比较；若任务要求逐字保真输出，不宜直接清洗。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The central decision is token retention, not example rejection. The official release contains a 50K pool and code; verify the reference model, masking format, and downstream task before carrying its threshold to another dataset.
核心决策是保留 token，而不是拒绝样本。官方发布包含 50K 数据池和代码；迁移阈值前必须核对参考模型、掩码格式和下游任务。
